title: Analysis stage event
description: One monotonic, run-scoped event for an analysis run (Core or W3). Produced by the Gateway, lifecycle, verifiers, and renderer; consumed by the run report aggregator. Never contains prompts, reasoning bodies, keys, or absolute paths.

run_id.description: Job or run identity the event belongs to.

sequence.description: Monotonic sequence within the run; strictly increasing.

step_id.description: Stable step id (e.g. P00..P15, decompose, solver-a, claim-verifier).

input_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the canonical input for this step.

output_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the canonical output for this step; empty when not produced.

contract.description: Structured contract id the step obeys, e.g. wuli.core-solve.v1.

failure_type.description: Stable low-cardinality failure code, empty on success.

retry_or_backjump.description: True when this step retried or a named backjump re-executed an affected task.

upstream_request_count.description: HTTP requests to the upstream model for this step.

usage.description: Redacted provider token usage; integer fields only.

items.description: Repository-relative artifact path only; never absolute.
